summary: Keep actionable human review gates visible in the Mac inbox and ask count

replay.detail: The app classifies existing inbox cards without replaying claims or changing projections.

schema.detail: No daemon, client-v0, stored format or generated-client contract changes.

rules.detail: Open human-gate cards offering review.approve, review.reject or review.request-changes remain visible as asks answered in Fractal. Withdrawn or resolved gates remain ignored; reviews never use work.done.

compatibility.detail: The app uses the existing external-answer path and existing review actions; older daemons and clients retain their contracts.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart, migration or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No new configuration, permission or manual migration is required.

recovery.detail: Restore the previous Mac app package pin to recover the former inbox classification. No daemon state recovery is needed.
